subtitle: A mild sweet potato, chickpea and spinach curry with rice and naan, suited to diners who prefer gentle spice.
quickAnswer: The Wetherspoons Sweet Potato, Chickpea & Spinach Curry costs a typical {price}, has {calories} kcal and comes with rice and soft naan bread. Prices vary by pub, with [Curry Club](/curry-club) pricing on Thursdays. Expect a mild tomato and coconut sauce, sweet potato chunks, tender chickpeas and wilted spinach.

taste:
This is a mild, warming curry, with natural sweet potato sweetness balanced by earthy chickpeas and gentle spice. The tomato and coconut sauce is rich rather than sharply hot, so the emphasis is on comfort and flavour rather than a chilli challenge. Generous sweet potato chunks give each mouthful substance, while the tender chickpeas add a different texture.

Wilted spinach sits within the sauce, adding a softer element to the chunky mixture. Fragrant rice and soft naan make the accompaniments part of the meal rather than extras you need to order separately. Served piping hot, it suits someone looking for a hearty curry without pronounced heat.
value:

Anyone avoiding milk or mustard should [check the current allergen](/allergen-information) information before ordering. Ask staff to confirm the curry and its rice and naan accompaniments together. Swaps or additions can change the allergens in the meal, so make your dietary requirements clear when discussing any changes.
